examples.zh: 为下次评审保留决策轨迹。
examples.en: Preserve the decision trail for the next review.

examples.zh: 决策轨迹解释了拒绝外包的原因。
examples.en: The decision trail explains why we rejected outsourcing.

examples.zh: 关闭事项前完成理由记录。
examples.en: Complete the rationale capture before closing the item.

examples.zh: 记录理由只需一小段文字。
examples.en: Rationale capture takes only a short paragraph.

examples.zh: 意见仍有分歧时保留异议记录。
examples.en: Maintain a dissent record when views remain divided.

examples.zh: 异议记录包含工程师的安全疑虑。
examples.en: The dissent record includes the engineer's safety concern.

examples.zh: 研讨会后更新假设登记表。
examples.en: Update the assumption register after the workshop.

examples.zh: 假设登记表标记了未经核实的需求数据。
examples.en: The assumption register flags unverified demand figures.

examples.zh: 为临时规则设定决策到期点。
examples.en: Set a decision expiry for the temporary rule.

examples.zh: 决策到期点会触发重新评审。
examples.en: The decision expiry prompts a fresh review.

examples.zh: 证据有限时作出可逆选择。
examples.en: Make a reversible choice while evidence is limited.

examples.zh: 租赁设备是可逆选择。
examples.en: Renting equipment is a reversible choice.

examples.zh: 将每个不可逆选择标记给高层审查。
examples.en: Flag every irreversible choice for senior review.

examples.zh: 拆除仓库是不可逆选择。
examples.en: Demolishing the warehouse is an irreversible choice.

examples.zh: 尽早分享数据以保住决策窗口。
examples.en: Protect the decision window by sharing the data early.

examples.zh: 我们的决策窗口在供应商停工前结束。
examples.en: Our decision window closes before the supplier's shutdown.

examples.zh: 升级处理时尊重权限边界。
examples.en: Respect the authority boundary during the escalation.

examples.zh: 权限边界不包含招聘决定。
examples.en: The authority boundary excludes hiring decisions.

examples.zh: 改变政策前达到同意门槛。
examples.en: Meet the consent threshold before changing the policy.

examples.zh: 同意门槛要求四份书面批准。
examples.en: The consent threshold requires four written approvals.

examples.zh: 出现新问题时维持议程纪律。
examples.en: Maintain agenda discipline when new issues emerge.

examples.zh: 议程纪律使评审控制在一小时内。
examples.en: Agenda discipline kept the review under an hour.

examples.zh: 开始时确认发言顺序。
examples.en: Confirm the speaking order at the start.

examples.zh: 发言顺序安排操作员先于经理发言。
examples.en: The speaking order puts operators before managers.

examples.zh: 暂存次要细节以防讨论超时。
examples.en: Prevent a timebox overrun by parking minor details.

examples.zh: 未解争议导致限时超时。
examples.en: The unresolved dispute caused a timebox overrun.

examples.zh: 投票前提出任何未解决异议。
examples.en: Surface any unresolved objection before the vote.

examples.zh: 有一项未解决异议涉及紧急通道。
examples.en: One unresolved objection concerns emergency access.

examples.zh: 将讨论支线与今天的决策分开。
examples.en: Separate the discussion fork from today's decision.

examples.zh: 培训成本成为单独的讨论支线。
examples.en: Training costs became a separate discussion fork.

examples.zh: 每三十分钟设置一次总结确认节点。
examples.en: Use a summary checkpoint every thirty minutes.

examples.zh: 总结确认节点揭示了相互冲突的假设。
examples.en: A summary checkpoint revealed conflicting assumptions.

examples.zh: 高风险变更不要依靠默示同意。
examples.en: Avoid silent agreement on high-risk changes.

examples.zh: 在这里不应把沉默算作默示同意。
examples.en: Silence should not count as silent agreement here.

examples.zh: 要求每位批准人明确表达赞同。
examples.en: Request explicit concurrence from every approver.

examples.zh: 我们需要安全负责人明确赞同。
examples.en: We need explicit concurrence from the safety lead.

examples.zh: 为未完成行动设定跟进节奏。
examples.en: Set a follow-up cadence for open actions.

examples.zh: 我们的跟进频率为每周两次。
examples.en: Our follow-up cadence is twice a week.

examples.zh: 只允许将有明确负责人的议题延后。
examples.en: Limit postponed agenda items to those with named owners.

examples.zh: 延后议题周四重新讨论。
examples.en: The postponed agenda item returns on Thursday.

examples.zh: 接收需求前定义产能边界。
examples.en: Define the capacity envelope before accepting demand.

examples.zh: 产能边界不包含周末生产。
examples.en: The capacity envelope excludes weekend production.

examples.zh: 在未来三周实施需求平滑。
examples.en: Apply demand smoothing across the next three weeks.

examples.zh: 较小的每周订单有助于需求平滑。
examples.en: Smaller weekly orders support demand smoothing.

examples.zh: 冻结计划前解决资源冲突。
examples.en: Resolve the resource collision before freezing the plan.

examples.zh: 两项审核造成了资源冲突。
examples.en: Two audits created a resource collision.

examples.zh: 交叉培训可以消除技能瓶颈。
examples.en: Cross-training can remove the skills bottleneck.

examples.zh: 焊工短缺造成了技能瓶颈。
examples.en: A shortage of welders created a skills bottleneck.

examples.zh: 为上线期设定工作负荷上限。
examples.en: Set a workload ceiling for the launch period.

examples.zh: 工作负荷上限保障了维护时间。
examples.en: The workload ceiling protects time for maintenance.

examples.zh: 恢复计划中限制加班风险敞口。
examples.en: Limit overtime exposure in the recovery plan.

examples.zh: 反复安排周末班增加了加班风险敞口。
examples.en: Repeated weekend shifts increased overtime exposure.

examples.zh: 保留备用产能用于紧急检验。
examples.en: Hold reserve capacity for urgent inspections.

examples.zh: 备用产能承接了紧急订单。
examples.en: Reserve capacity absorbed the rush order.

examples.zh: 制造计划中遵守顺序约束。
examples.en: Honor the sequence constraint in the build plan.

examples.zh: 先固化后测试是一项顺序约束。
examples.en: Curing before testing is a sequence constraint.

examples.zh: 为假期那周准备人员应急安排。
examples.en: Prepare a staffing contingency for the holiday week.

examples.zh: 我们的人员应急安排采用受训替班操作员。
examples.en: Our staffing contingency uses trained relief operators.

examples.zh: 向两个团队解释资源分配取舍。
examples.en: Explain the allocation trade-off to both teams.

examples.zh: 这项分配取舍会推迟较小项目。
examples.en: The allocation trade-off delays the smaller project.

examples.zh: 批准前检查报价到期情况。
examples.en: Check quote expiration before approval.

examples.zh: 报价到期后我们需要重新询价。
examples.en: Quote expiration requires us to request updated prices.

examples.zh: 检查需求是否达到价格折扣门槛。
examples.en: Check whether demand reaches the price-break threshold.

examples.zh: 价格折扣门槛为五百件。
examples.en: The price-break threshold is five hundred units.

examples.zh: 签署前限制商务风险敞口。
examples.en: Limit commercial exposure before signing.

examples.zh: 无上限罚款增加了我们的商务风险敞口。
examples.en: Uncapped penalties increase our commercial exposure.

examples.zh: 在提案中量化最低订购量负担。
examples.en: Quantify the minimum-order burden in the proposal.

examples.zh: 合并订单可降低最低订购量负担。
examples.en: Shared orders reduce the minimum-order burden.

examples.zh: 按预测数量审查工装摊销。
examples.en: Review tooling amortization across the forecast volume.

examples.zh: 工装摊销使每件成本增加两美元。
examples.en: Tooling amortization adds two dollars per unit.

examples.zh: 开票前验证阶段付款触发条件。
examples.en: Verify the staged-payment trigger before invoicing.

examples.zh: 安装签核是阶段付款触发条件。
examples.en: Installation sign-off is the staged-payment trigger.

examples.zh: 在报价中说明运费假设。
examples.en: State the freight assumption in the quotation.

examples.zh: 运费假设采用标准海运。
examples.en: The freight assumption uses standard sea shipping.

examples.zh: 仅在收益明确时批准交期溢价。
examples.en: Approve a lead-time premium only with clear benefit.

examples.zh: 交期溢价超过了预期节省额。
examples.en: The lead-time premium exceeds the expected savings.

examples.zh: 重新谈判前评估供应商议价力。
examples.en: Assess supplier leverage before renegotiation.

examples.zh: 第二供应来源削弱了供应商议价力。
examples.en: A second source weakens supplier leverage.

examples.zh: 为新零件开展自制外购评估。
examples.en: Conduct a make-or-buy review for the new part.

examples.zh: 自制外购评估包含维护成本。
examples.en: The make-or-buy review includes maintenance costs.

examples.zh: 比较产线前检查测量偏倚。
examples.en: Detect measurement bias before comparing lines.

examples.zh: 磨损的量具引入了测量偏倚。
examples.en: The worn gauge introduced measurement bias.

examples.zh: 用相同样本验证量测一致性。
examples.en: Verify gauge agreement with shared samples.

examples.zh: 校准后量测一致性得到提高。
examples.en: Gauge agreement improved after calibration.

examples.zh: 为相关性研究采用比较基准。
examples.en: Use a comparison benchmark for the correlation study.

examples.zh: 比较基准来自认证样本。
examples.en: The comparison benchmark comes from certified samples.

examples.zh: 整个调查期间保留样本溯源记录。
examples.en: Preserve sample lineage through the investigation.

examples.zh: 样本溯源记录将试管与生产批次关联。
examples.en: Sample lineage links the vial to its production lot.

examples.zh: 增加检验前绘制缺陷流出路径。
examples.en: Map the defect escape path before adding inspection.

examples.zh: 缺陷流出路径绕过了最后一道摄像检测。
examples.en: The defect escape path bypassed the final camera.

examples.zh: 提高对浅划痕的检验灵敏度。
examples.en: Improve inspection sensitivity for shallow scratches.

examples.zh: 改善照明提高了检验灵敏度。
examples.en: Better lighting increased inspection sensitivity.

examples.zh: 降低误接收风险时不要拖慢每个批次。
examples.en: Reduce false-accept risk without slowing every lot.

examples.zh: 收紧阈值可降低误接收风险。
examples.en: A tighter threshold lowers false-accept risk.

examples.zh: 平衡误拒收风险与客户保护。
examples.en: Balance false-reject risk against customer protection.

examples.zh: 传感器脏污提高了误拒收风险。
examples.en: Dirty sensors raised the false-reject risk.

examples.zh: 权衡相互冲突报告的证据价值。
examples.en: Weigh evidentiary value across conflicting reports.

examples.zh: 直接观察具有更高证据权重。
examples.en: Direct observations carry greater evidentiary weight.

examples.zh: 提高看板的信噪比。
examples.en: Raise the signal-to-noise ratio in the dashboard.

examples.zh: 去除重复警报提高了信噪比。
examples.en: Removing duplicate alerts improved the signal-to-noise ratio.

examples.zh: 执行前记录基线偏离。
examples.en: Document the baseline deviation before execution.

examples.zh: 基线偏离需要书面批准。
examples.en: The baseline deviation needs written approval.

examples.zh: 交付时拒绝未经说明的范围替换。
examples.en: Reject silent scope substitution during delivery.

examples.zh: 范围替换导致所需报告未完成。
examples.en: Scope substitution left the requested report unfinished.

examples.zh: 通过版本比较检测需求漂移。
examples.en: Detect requirement drift through version comparison.

examples.zh: 每周审查发现了逐步发生的需求漂移。
examples.en: Weekly reviews exposed gradual requirement drift.

examples.zh: 切换期间防止接口失效。
examples.en: Prevent an interface break during the cutover.

examples.zh: 字段改名导致接口失效。
examples.en: A renamed field caused an interface break.

examples.zh: 改变文件格式前评估次生影响。
examples.en: Assess the secondary ripple before changing the file format.

examples.zh: 次生连锁影响波及了开票流程。
examples.en: The secondary ripple affected the billing process.

examples.zh: 按决策类型衡量审批延迟。
examples.en: Measure approval latency by decision type.

examples.zh: 缺少签名增加了审批延迟。
examples.en: Missing signatures increased approval latency.

examples.zh: 监控整个项目群的变更过载情况。
examples.en: Monitor change overload across the program.

examples.zh: 三项同时推行的变更造成变更过载。
examples.en: Three simultaneous rollouts caused change overload.

examples.zh: 部署前定义回退阈值。
examples.en: Define a reversion threshold before deployment.

examples.zh: 十笔交易失败就达到回退阈值。
examples.en: Ten failed transactions reach the reversion threshold.

examples.zh: 防止无关变更影响切换窗口。
examples.en: Protect the transition window from unrelated changes.

examples.zh: 我们的切换窗口持续四十分钟。
examples.en: Our transition window lasts forty minutes.

examples.zh: 将迁移债务作为明确工作追踪，不要隐藏工作量。
examples.en: Track migration debt as named work, not hidden effort.

examples.zh: 清理旧账户仍是一项迁移债务。
examples.en: Old account cleanup remains migration debt.

examples.zh: 为每项关键服务设定恢复目标。
examples.en: Set a restoration target for each critical service.

examples.zh: 恢复目标是在中午前恢复全部服务。
examples.en: The restoration target is full service by noon.

examples.zh: 完全失效前报告服务降级。
examples.en: Report service degradation before complete failure.

examples.zh: 搜索缓慢表明服务降级。
examples.en: Slow searches indicate service degradation.

examples.zh: 围绕受影响单元建立故障遏制措施。
examples.en: Establish failure containment around the affected cell.

examples.zh: 独立电路可改善故障遏制。
examples.en: Separate power circuits improve failure containment.

examples.zh: 恢复供电后遵循恢复顺序。
examples.en: Follow the restoration sequence after power returns.

examples.zh: 恢复顺序以数据库检查开始。
examples.en: The restoration sequence starts with database checks.

examples.zh: 在周末测试中考虑依赖服务中断。
examples.en: Plan for a dependency outage in the weekend test.

examples.zh: 依赖服务中断阻止了订单确认。
examples.en: A dependency outage blocked order confirmation.

examples.zh: 迁移前验证备用方案就绪度。
examples.en: Verify fallback readiness before the migration.

examples.zh: 演练确认了备用方案已就绪。
examples.en: The drill confirmed fallback readiness.

examples.zh: 加快积压消减时不要降低质量。
examples.en: Accelerate backlog burn-down without lowering quality.

examples.zh: 人员培训期间积压消减放慢了。
examples.en: Backlog burn-down slowed during staff training.

examples.zh: 按明确优先级管理激增队列。
examples.en: Manage the surge queue with clear priorities.

examples.zh: 激增待办队列包含紧急维修请求。
examples.en: The surge queue contains urgent repair requests.

examples.zh: 在恢复评审中披露残余风险敞口。
examples.en: Disclose residual exposure at the recovery review.

examples.zh: 夜班的残余风险敞口仍然很高。
examples.en: Residual exposure remains high during night shifts.

examples.zh: 关闭前设置防复发措施。
examples.en: Install a recurrence guard before closure.

examples.zh: 防复发措施会阻止重复订单号。
examples.en: The recurrence guard blocks duplicate order numbers.

examples.zh: 根据现有证据调整主张确定程度。
examples.en: Calibrate claim strength to the available evidence.

examples.zh: 样本较小限制了主张的确定程度。
examples.en: A small sample limits claim strength.

examples.zh: 用直接测试填补推理缺口。
examples.en: Close the inference gap with a direct test.

examples.zh: 推理缺口在于相关性与因果性之间。
examples.en: The inference gap lies between correlation and causation.

examples.zh: 归责前追溯机制链。
examples.en: Trace the mechanism chain before assigning blame.

examples.zh: 机制链将湿气与腐蚀联系起来。
examples.en: The mechanism chain connects moisture to corrosion.

examples.zh: 用数据检验替代解释。
examples.en: Test an alternative explanation against the data.

examples.zh: 季节性需求提供了一种替代解释。
examples.en: Seasonal demand offers an alternative explanation.

examples.zh: 声称有效果前建立反事实基准。
examples.en: Build a what-if baseline before claiming impact.

examples.zh: 反事实基准假设没有加班。
examples.en: The what-if baseline assumes no overtime.

examples.zh: 为预测添加置信度陈述。
examples.en: Add a confidence statement to the forecast.

examples.zh: 置信度陈述指出历史数据有限。
examples.en: The confidence statement notes limited historical data.

examples.zh: 指出缺失证明点，不要隐藏它。
examples.en: Name the missing proof point instead of hiding it.

examples.zh: 重复试验是缺失的证明点。
examples.en: A repeat trial is the missing proof point.

examples.zh: 升级处理前评估来源可信度。
examples.en: Assess source credibility before escalation.

examples.zh: 来源可信度取决于能否获取原始记录。
examples.en: Source credibility depends on access to original records.

examples.zh: 展示两个选项以减少框架效应。
examples.en: Show both options to reduce the framing effect.

examples.zh: 不同措辞产生了框架效应。
examples.en: Different wording produced a framing effect.

examples.zh: 改善叙述连贯性时不要删除限定条件。
examples.en: Improve narrative coherence without removing caveats.

examples.zh: 清晰的时间线改善了叙述连贯性。
examples.en: A clear timeline improved narrative coherence.

examples.zh: 谈判前明确利益相关方授权。
examples.en: Clarify the stakeholder mandate before negotiation.

examples.zh: 利益相关方授权允许开展有限试点。
examples.en: The stakeholder mandate permits a limited pilot.

examples.zh: 争取发起人关注受阻的决策。
examples.en: Secure sponsor attention for the blocked decision.

examples.zh: 发起人的关注帮助解决了资金争议。
examples.en: Sponsor attention helped resolve the funding dispute.

examples.zh: 扩大试点前填补治理缺口。
examples.en: Close the governance gap before scaling the pilot.

examples.zh: 审批权限不清造成了治理缺口。
examples.en: Unclear approval rights created a governance gap.

examples.zh: 为夜班公布升级路径。
examples.en: Publish the escalation route for night shifts.

examples.zh: 升级路径包含紧急联系电话。
examples.en: The escalation route includes an emergency number.

examples.zh: 以证据和日期完成责任移交。
examples.en: Complete ownership transfer with evidence and dates.

examples.zh: 责任移交于签核后生效。
examples.en: Ownership transfer takes effect after sign-off.

examples.zh: 加强逾期行动的问责闭环。
examples.en: Strengthen the accountability loop for overdue actions.

examples.zh: 每周检查保持问责闭环运作。
examples.en: Weekly checks keep the accountability loop active.

examples.zh: 在上线计划中绘制跨部门依赖。
examples.en: Map the cross-functional dependency in the launch plan.

examples.zh: 这项跨部门依赖需要共同排程。
examples.en: This cross-functional dependency requires shared scheduling.

examples.zh: 通过共享记录提高决策透明度。
examples.en: Increase decision transparency through a shared log.

examples.zh: 公布理由提高了决策透明度。
examples.en: Published reasons improved decision transparency.

examples.zh: 申请例外前确认偏差批准权。
examples.en: Identify the variance approval right before requesting an exception.

examples.zh: 质量主管拥有偏差批准权。
examples.en: The quality director holds the variance approval right.

examples.zh: 为恢复项目群商定监督节奏。
examples.en: Agree an oversight cadence for the recovery program.

examples.zh: 调试期间监督频率会提高。
examples.en: The oversight cadence increases during commissioning.

examples.zh: 结束会议前检查行动项完整度。
examples.en: Check action completeness before ending the meeting.

examples.zh: 缺少期限降低了行动项完整度。
examples.en: Missing deadlines reduced action completeness.

examples.zh: 在每个阶段边界衡量交接质量。
examples.en: Measure handoff quality at each phase boundary.

examples.zh: 共同走查提高了交接质量。
examples.en: A joint walkthrough improved handoff quality.

examples.zh: 消除返工动因，而不是增加检验。
examples.en: Remove the rework driver instead of adding inspection.

examples.zh: 过时图纸是主要返工动因。
examples.en: Outdated drawings were the main rework driver.

examples.zh: 上线后确定经验待办清单的优先级。
examples.en: Prioritize the learning backlog after the launch.

examples.zh: 经验待办清单包含两项未解决的培训缺口。
examples.en: The learning backlog includes two unresolved training gaps.

examples.zh: 减少审批流程中的阻力。
examples.en: Reduce process friction in the approval flow.

examples.zh: 重复录入数据造成流程阻力。
examples.en: Repeated data entry creates process friction.

examples.zh: 用结果数据衡量防护措施表现。
examples.en: Measure safeguard performance with result data.

examples.zh: 传感器受损后防护措施表现下降。
examples.en: Safeguard performance declined after sensor damage.

examples.zh: 在结果之外同步追踪行为指标。
examples.en: Track a behavior indicator alongside the result.

examples.zh: 清单完成率是一项行为指标。
examples.en: Checklist completion is a behavior indicator.

examples.zh: 为每项干预选择最终结果指标。
examples.en: Select an end-result measure for each intervention.

examples.zh: 最终结果指标追踪客户退货。
examples.en: The end-result measure tracks customer returns.

examples.zh: 试点期间缩短反馈延迟。
examples.en: Shorten feedback latency during the pilot.

examples.zh: 每日评审减少了反馈延迟。
examples.en: Daily reviews reduced feedback latency.

examples.zh: 扩大推广前完成一个适应循环。
examples.en: Complete an adaptation cycle before wider rollout.

examples.zh: 每个适应循环以重新测试结束。
examples.en: Each adaptation cycle ends with fresh testing.

examples.zh: 人口众多的地区需要稳健的服务计划。
examples.en: A populous region needs a robust service plan.

examples.zh: 该诊所服务一个人口众多的地区。
examples.en: The clinic serves a populous district.

examples.zh: 董事会本周面临一项重大决定。
examples.en: The board faces a momentous decision this week.

examples.zh: 签署条约是意义重大的时刻。
examples.en: Signing the treaty was a momentous occasion.

examples.zh: 变更规模之大要求分阶段实施。
examples.en: The sheer scale of the change requires staging.

examples.zh: 请求数量之大令我们惊讶。
examples.en: The sheer volume of requests surprised us.

examples.zh: 文章讨论了一场总统选举。
examples.en: The article discusses a presidential election.

examples.zh: 档案馆保存着总统演讲稿。
examples.en: The archive holds presidential speeches.

examples.zh: 现任领导人为当前政策辩护。
examples.en: The incumbent leader defended the current policy.

examples.zh: 现任市长参加了辩论。
examples.en: The incumbent mayor attended the debate.

examples.zh: 领先的挑战者质疑最终计票结果。
examples.en: The leading challenger disputed the final count.

examples.zh: 挑战者提出了不同策略。
examples.en: The challenger proposed a different strategy.

examples.zh: 新证据可能推翻之前的结果。
examples.en: New evidence could overturn the earlier result.

examples.zh: 上诉可能推翻该裁决。
examples.en: The appeal could overturn the ruling.

examples.zh: 将市场预测视为不确定的证据。
examples.en: Treat a market prediction as uncertain evidence.

examples.zh: 她的预测被证明过于乐观。
examples.en: Her prediction proved too optimistic.

examples.zh: 反复否认可能让读者觉得受到心理操纵。
examples.en: Readers may feel gaslighted by repeated denials.

examples.zh: 自己的记录被否认时，他觉得受到心理操纵。
examples.en: He felt gaslighted when his records were dismissed.

examples.zh: 判断报道前仔细读标题。
examples.en: Read the headline carefully before judging the report.

examples.zh: 新闻标题漏掉了一项重要条件。
examples.en: The headline left out an important condition.

examples.zh: 势均力敌的竞争可能因微小变化而改变。
examples.en: A knife-edge contest can change with a small shift.

examples.zh: 投票成了一场势均力敌的较量。
examples.en: The vote became a knife-edge contest.

examples.zh: 提案以微弱优势通过。
examples.en: The proposal passed by a narrow margin.

examples.zh: 获胜差距仅为两票。
examples.en: The winning margin was just two votes.

examples.zh: 为大范围中断准备替代路线。
examples.en: Prepare alternate routes for widespread disruptions.

examples.zh: 暴风雨造成的中断延误了早间配送。
examples.en: Storm disruptions delayed the morning deliveries.

examples.zh: 区分被指称的违规与已证实的违规。
examples.en: Separate an alleged violation from a proven one.

examples.zh: 报告描述了一起被指称的违规行为。
examples.en: The report describes an alleged breach.

examples.zh: 调查人员检验延误是否人为造成。
examples.en: Investigators tested whether the delay was engineered.

examples.zh: 这次突然退出经过精心策划。
examples.en: The surprise exit was carefully engineered.

examples.zh: 平台以书面形式承认了该限制。
examples.en: The platform acknowledged the restriction in writing.

examples.zh: 她立即承认了错误。
examples.en: She acknowledged the error immediately.

examples.zh: 审查因访问限制而受阻。
examples.en: The review was hindered by access restrictions.

examples.zh: 大雨阻碍了维修工作。
examples.en: Heavy rain hindered the repair work.

examples.zh: 审核前记录所有访问限制。
examples.en: Document all access restrictions before the audit.

examples.zh: 这些限制仅在午夜后适用。
examples.en: The restrictions apply only after midnight.

examples.zh: 比较两个渠道的受众参与度。
examples.en: Compare audience engagement across the two channels.

examples.zh: 研讨会鼓励积极参与互动。
examples.en: The workshop encouraged active engagement.

examples.zh: 总结对其中一个选项作了有利描述。
examples.en: The summary gave one option a favorable portrayal.

examples.zh: 我们收到了对原型的正面反馈。
examples.en: We received favorable feedback on the prototype.

examples.zh: 检验这种模式是否并非仅仅巧合。
examples.en: Test whether the pattern is more than a mere coincidence.

examples.zh: 他们日期相同只是巧合。
examples.en: Their matching dates were a coincidence.

examples.zh: 正式审判适用无罪推定。
examples.en: A presumption of innocence applies in a formal trial.

examples.zh: 这项推定需要更强支持。
examples.en: This presumption needs stronger support.

examples.zh: 没有记录，这种否认可能缺乏可信性。
examples.en: The denial may lack plausibility without records.

examples.zh: 时间线使她的解释具有可信性。
examples.en: The timeline gives her explanation plausibility.

examples.zh: 发起人直接介入以打破僵局。
examples.en: The sponsor intervened directly to break the deadlock.

examples.zh: 调解人在谈判破裂前介入。
examples.en: A mediator intervened before talks collapsed.

examples.zh: 清醒评估剩余风险。
examples.en: Give a clear-sighted assessment of the remaining risk.

examples.zh: 她清醒的建议改变了我们的计划。
examples.en: Her clear-sighted advice changed our plan.
